anchor_fox.prompt: Studio product photograph of a small origami fox folded from one sheet of vermilion red washi paper with faint gold flecks, crisp sharp creases, a pointed snout, two triangular ears and a long folded tail; the reverse side of the paper is cream white and shows inside the ears and at the tip of the tail, standing in three-quarter view on a plain warm grey paper backdrop, soft even light, the whole fox sharp and fully visible.
anchor_fox.caption: Studio product photograph on a wide, plain warm grey paper backdrop, lit by soft, even diffused light with a restrained shadow directly beneath the subject. Centered in the frame, a small origami fox folded from one sheet of vermilion red washi paper stands fully visible in three-quarter view, its body facing left and its head turned toward the viewer. The fox has a compact angular body, a pointed snout, two upright triangular ears, and a long folded tail curving behind it toward the right. Its exterior is covered in vermilion red paper scattered with faint metallic gold flecks. Crisp, sharp creases define the face, chest, legs, and layered folds, with the pointed nose projecting forward and the narrow legs planted on the paper surface. The reverse side of the washi is cream white and shows inside both triangular ears and at the folded tip of the long tail, forming clean contrasting inner planes. The fox’s entire silhouette remains sharp from ear tips to paws and tail, with generous empty space on both sides. A pale contact shadow anchors the folded fox against the seamless warm grey paper surface, while the backdrop remains untextured and free of additional objects or text.

anchor_crane.prompt: Studio product photograph of an origami crane folded from deep indigo paper printed with tiny white stars, wings spread, standing on a plain warm grey paper backdrop, soft even light, the whole crane sharp and fully visible.
anchor_crane.caption: Studio product photograph, shot straight-on with soft, even diffused lighting and a deep depth of field, keeping the entire origami crane sharp and fully visible. Centered against a plain warm grey paper backdrop, a folded origami crane stands upright with both wings spread wide in a broad symmetrical silhouette. The crane is folded from deep indigo paper printed with tiny white five-pointed stars distributed across every visible fold. Its long angular neck rises from the body and bends toward the left, ending in a small pointed head with a narrow triangular beak. The body forms a compact faceted base in the lower center, supported by two thin folded legs. The left and right wings extend laterally across most of the wide composition, each built from crisp geometric planes with sharply defined creases and pointed outer tips. The indigo paper catches restrained highlights along the raised folds while the white stars remain small and evenly legible. A pale contact shadow rests directly beneath the crane on the warm grey surface, with generous empty space surrounding the wings and no additional objects or text.

anchor_girl.prompt: Full-body studio photograph of a girl of about eight with a short black bob, round tortoiseshell glasses, a bright yellow raincoat and yellow rubber boots, standing and smiling shyly, holding a clear umbrella, plain warm grey backdrop, soft even light.
anchor_girl.caption: Studio photograph, full-body eye-level portrait against a plain warm grey seamless backdrop, lit with soft, even light that casts a pale shadow beneath the subject’s boots. Centered in the wide composition stands an East Asian girl of about eight with fair skin, a short black bob, and round tortoiseshell glasses. She wears a bright yellow hooded raincoat with a front zipper and two small flap pockets, along with matching yellow rubber boots. Her entire body is visible from the top of her hair to the soles of her boots. She holds a clear transparent umbrella above and behind her with both hands, its curved handle resting near her waist and the umbrella canopy spreading across the upper half of the frame. The clear vinyl canopy has a thin transparent rim and catches broad rectangular reflections from the studio lights. She faces the camera with her shoulders drawn inward, her chin lowered, and a small closed-mouth smile, with her eyes meeting the lens through the round glasses. Her feet turn inward and one boot rests half a step behind the other. The umbrella is held upright in front of her without obscuring her face, leaving her yellow raincoat and bob unobstructed. The warm grey floor and backdrop merge without a visible horizon line, with generous empty space on both sides of the girl and umbrella.

001_s01_1.prompt: Cinematic film still of a handcrafted miniature set, photographed with a macro lens, shallow depth of field, moody teal-and-amber color grade, soft film grain. Night exterior of a tiny old paper shop on a narrow rainy street, warm light glowing in its small shop window, a hand-painted wooden sign reading "KAMI" above the door, neon reflections rippling in puddles on the cobblestones.
001_s01_1.caption: Full-color cinematic film still of a handcrafted miniature set, photographed at night with a macro lens and shallow depth of field, with soft film grain and a moody teal-and-amber color grade. A tiny old paper shop stands in the center of a narrow rain-soaked street, its handmade façade built from uneven brown paper, miniature timber boards, and visible brushwork. Above the small recessed door, a hand-painted wooden sign bears the word "KAMI" in cream block letters, with chipped edges and dark red brush marks. The shop window glows amber behind thin rain-streaked glass, revealing miniature shelves packed with folded paper, envelopes, and small stacks of books. A crooked paper awning hangs over the window, and a narrow teal neon tube beside the doorway casts a cool reflection across the wet wall. Rain falls through the scene as fine diagonal streaks, beading on the sign and dripping from the awning. In the foreground, irregular cobblestones form a miniature street, their dark surfaces broken by shallow puddles reflecting the amber window, cyan neon, and the sign reading "KAMI". Ripples spread through the puddles, stretching the reflections into wavering bands of gold and teal. A tiny wooden door with a brass-colored knob sits below the window, reached by two worn stone steps. On the left, a crooked neighboring wall and a miniature drainpipe recede into blur; on the right, the street narrows into dark teal shapes with two distant amber window lights. The nearest cobbles and shopfront remain crisp while the foreground puddle edges and distant alley dissolve into soft focus.

Switch off the warm amber interior light completely: the books, shelves, and interior are now visible only in cold blue moonlight, with no glow, amber reflections, or warm illumination inside the window. Rain falls through the blue light, streaking across the glass and collecting in droplets along the awning edge, sill, and wooden frame. Preserve the sign above the window with the exact text "KAMI", now rendered in cold blue-gray tones, and keep the adjacent wooden door and cyan vertical tube as subdued, dim background elements. Replace the former interior glow with deep blue reflections from the moonlit rain on the wet glass and the slick window ledge. The foreground becomes the rain-soaked cobblestones directly below the window, covered by shallow puddles reflecting only cold blue moonlight and scattered raindrop ripples; remove all traces of the former orange shop light while preserving the original miniature scale, materials, rain, and street setting.
